title: “BRADFORD” by Polite Bureaux is a willful track for a city on the rise
htmlContent: Polite Bureaux’s new single, “BRADFORD,” is the first preview of their upcoming album, EXCEPT YOUR SKINT, which will be released on April 11. “BRADFORD” bursts with energy, mixing a rough, edgy style with a sense of rebellion that reflects the spirit of the city it’s named after. The song is already making waves, especially with support from Bradford’s bid for City of Culture in 2025. It has gained thousands of views on social media platforms like Instagram and YouTube, and it’s easy to see why. “BRADFORD” has a sense of urgency, capturing the essence of a city that doesn’t get the attention it deserves. https://open.spotify.com/album/5mzs9vw665ikxaRFsCW5S8?si=jBoicyLNSdKf2-FkqES9yw The music features gritty guitars and powerful drums, while the vocals are raw and filled with emotion. “BRADFORD” shines with authenticity, showcasing the energetic spirit of the city and the band. This single sets the stage for EXCEPT YOUR SKINT, promising an album that addresses challenges and celebrates the realities of working class life.
